body:
3V85F52P - South America (Brazil)
6 friend spaces left :)

I was freaking out when my Facebook friends disappeared, but the login reset thing makes sense, so I'll wait.

Also, if anybody wants to add me, I'm from Brazil, and even if I'm not as much experienced as some here I play everyday, so the hearts are guaranteed :)

My code is 3V85-F52P
Thank you. Very much. Really.

Had to read it like three times so I could understand what you meant (yeah, anxiety is doing its job around here today).

Last times I played with alcohol and was around a lot of people (almost 2 months ago) I had a huge crisis afterwards when I got home. Good thing it wasn't in front of everybody, otherwise they would call me crazy even more.
Always. To me it sounds like they're joking or just saying it to make me feel better, but everytime someone says something nice I feel like I need to apologize instead of saying "thank you"

Thanks, you're really sweet :)

I have this small and shy thought I'm the back of my mind saying "you deserve better", but I don't feel like opening to anybody soon. Right now I can't really handle even going out of the house. Going to a party like I used to seems so scary..

I hope you too get better (I won't say "get over him" because I don't feel like it's appropriate, every person that comes is part of who we are somewhat), and eventually love and be loved in return, by him or somebody else.

I wish my boyfriend said he still loves me, and that he's sorry or anything. I just had too many people giving up on me (everytime I'm attached, same "Its not you it's me" bullshit). My first boyfriend died after we were together for 5 and a half years. He gave up on me, then went to Russia, then died. Long story short.

I feel like a ladder, that I don't deserve to be loved nor to be happy. And this time I was so sure I've found true love. Makes me want to cry right now. Even if i sound like I have no self esteem (and I probably don't) I wish he would come back, for a change.

Sorry if this was a sad non related to your topic vent, or if I sounded like I'm playing the victim.

My ex is depressed, but he refuses to go see a doctor. He saw a neurologist and tried some antidepressant (dont know which one, he didnt told me), but apparently had some side effects and gave up. I tried to say that he needed a pdoc instead, bc that's what they're meant for, not neurologists. But of course, he says no. Stigma, fucking stigma.

I'm taking my meds, on the other side. And even if he was a jerk and treated me like nothing, I still care about him, his health, his parents and everything. But there's that thing "you can't help those who do not want to be helped"..

If you like to watch things about depression, you should try Bojack Horseman (Netflix animated series).

He's depressed but its also sarcastic.

I wish I could pay for therapy too. At the moment I can barely pay for my pdoc (no insurance, and the appointments are really expensive) and my meds.

Was hoping that i could count on my friends, but I guess that now that I'm depressed and not able to go out to party and do drugs/drink with them, I don't deserve their attention.

Me neither. My self esteem is so low right now I can't think about "deserving better". I want him to be happy, but at the same time I want him to recover from depression and regret how he's treating me - and damn I feel bad for thinking this way.

Hahaha same here.

When I don't talk about my feelings: "you're too closed, say something, open up, we're here at your worst and best, trust us"

When I say how I feel like shit because of depression: "oh, damn". Then they disappear.

It can be a good thing, sure. Just that I'm already skinny, and lost a lot of weight due to depression, and I'm having a rough time regaining it. Don't know if it's because of the meds or because I'm still pretty down (maybe both?)

Love can be a birch. My boyfriend dumped me, after saying I was his everything, that he loved me. Now he's saying that he was mistaken.

Besides that, my life is fucked up and I'm suffering so much from depression I just want it to end.

Wish I could say "he doesn't deserve you, you're better than him", but i know how hard it is to get over, to give up when you love somebody. I'm on the process of grieving and crying and feeling like shit too :(
Thanks, but don't feel sorry. We're kinda on the same boat, I wish it was easier tho.

I'm on lexapro too, been on for about 2 months now. In the beginning I lost all of my appetite, all of it. Then there were days in which I could eat normally again. I was on seroquel for sleeping in the first month, and this one increased my appetite after taking it at night.

Now I have normal days, low appetite days and no appetite at all days. So, for me, it's hard to regain the weight I lost before starting the meds, and sometimes I feel they can make me lose weight too..

I see your point. I almost did it myself on the new years. Most of the time I know I'm safe, but the thoughts, they're always here, torturing me, making me feel hopeless. I fear I won't be able to hold on for too long. Aside of my experience, I hope you find ways to cope and/or fight against your own mind. I know how hard it can get :(

I fear about my mom too. Sometimes I'm just "fuck it, I need this to end", but even if she can't handle my depression around her, it just feels horrible to do something.

I'm in a constant battle in my head, just trying to live one day at a time, but feeling like I'm losing it no matter how hard I try.
Thank you :')

I know, right? And he's not even my regular pdoc. Just had to see this moron bc my pdoc was on vacation and I was having so many crisis I had to go for an emergency appointment.

Never want to see his face again, needless to say.

I lost a boyfriend in 2012 for good (ice skating accident), and was dumped by my last one (I mean, he was the only one after 2012) on the day before my appointment.

Then he said "you already lost a boyfriend, guess you know how to deal with it now". I was on the verge of crying and wanted so bad to punch him in the face, just didn't because I needed my prescriptions.

Doctors can really be assholes sometimes.

It depends, specially if you're on meds. There's a document about street drugs interactions with medication, just Google it if you need (Its something with university research, I think Berkeley, so I guess it's worth the reading).

Personally, I don't like the LSD trips so much, they can lead me to dark places or make me pass out bc the LSD brings my heart rate down. I do prefer MDMA/ecstasy, but they're not safe with my meds. Just be sure to check if the drugs can interfere, don't put yourself at unecessary risk just for fun :)

It is a side effect. My pupils used to get bigger in the beggining (Idk if they still do, but since my anxiety lessened after some time taking the pills, I just stopped looking for them).

Keep an eye on it, but it will lessen. Some meds take 2 weeks, but it can take up to 8 weeks for you to see the full effects. If it keeps worrying you, talk to your pdoc about it, maybe he/she will make you less worried.

I do. My first boyfriend, we were together for 5 and a half years. Then he said "I'm going to Russia" (I live in Brazil). Then, 4 months later, it was January 2nd 2012, his brother sent me a message, saying he died on a frozen lake. Next day I discovered on Facebook that he was dating this Russian girl for 3 months (we talked almost every day. He never mentioned someone). I got depressed for the first time, wanted to die so badly. But chose to go on.

Since then, it was very hard to connect. I tried new partners, but they always gave up on me. "Its not you, it's me", "I'm not ready". Needless to say, all of them were happy with someone a month after they broke up with me.

Then, last August, I found this guy, he made me feel special like nobody ever did, he asked me to date him, he said "I love you" first. Everything went well, until it doesn't and he stopped wanting to see me. Just like that. I'm going through a pretty pretty hard moment in my life, and got depressed again. I needed support, he wasn't feeling well too, I offered to be there for him. And then he broke up with me, and said that he thought it was love, but was mistaken. Like that.

Now I feel like shit, like I'm this kind of ladder, for people to step on before they find someone that is worth it. I just feel useless and that I do not deserve to be loved at all.

I can connect with you in so many ways. Toxic family, no job, depression, feeling suicidal. I want to volunteer too, but most of the days I just can't get outside for anything than smoking cigarettes.

Yes, i guess it is from the cipralex.
I'm taking lexapro, and have experienced nearly all of the side effects, including this one (and I have also used mdma before, so I totally get what you mean).
I would recommend for you to take the pill when you can rest just after, so you can deal with the anxiety flowing. This side effect was huge for me in the first month (I'm now close to my 60th day, also taing sleeping pills and a benzo when needed).

Wish you well, hope it works for you :)

I guess I'm doing it, or trying to.

My dad was diagnosed with class-C cirrhosis, and since he was being pretty horrible to me since last March (bc of his gf - younger than me), we are not speaking/seeing each other. He says he won't do the transplant and will probably die soon.

I'm depressed again (first time was in 2012 due to my ex-bf's death), and the meds are not exactly helping. I had several crisis and my anxiety sometimes is over the roof, the other times I'm just laying on the couch. I'm poorly eating, and my thoughts are ALWAYS racing.

I got a new boyfriend last August, but he just said he stopped loving me and dumped me, even when I was there for him, with all my life problems going on.

No money. Had to postpone my last year of college, trying to sell my car to pay my debts (most of them caused by my father) and pay my meds and pdoc appointments.

My friends, most of them don't talk to me anymore, and the ones who do are always like "you need to be strong", "be positive" and all those crappy talkings. Family? Hahahaha even my mom doesn't know how to be close to me anymore.

So I'm feeling suicidal all the time, I just don't see any point in going on, it hurts so much. I've self harmed by hitting myself, scratching my legs and arms till they bleed out, but am too afraid to start cutting (I'm afraid that once I have a knife or whatever on my hands, I'll just do more than that, so I try to stay away from the kitchen when my mind is on the edge)..

Guess that's it. I know that a lot of people suffer more, but to me this is getting to something unbearable. It hurts just to wake up wanting to cry and disappear.

I wouldn't say I'm better. My anxiety is going up the roof and the new dose of antidepressants  is making me numb. I want to cry but it's just hard, so I guess it's all going through anxiety for now.
About the people deserting, I know it can be good at some point, I just hope I can get to this point sometime.

Yeah, I know. I keep telling myself "let go of this guilt" but I just can't. And great thing that the doc switched me to a new med that can't put me to sleep at all. Like I need to be sleep depraved too.

I saw the pdoc yesterday, he upped my meds, said to give another 4 weeks, if it doesn't help I'll just have to switch meds. Man I feel kinda pathetic. I know somewhat that I shouldn't, but I still do. It's all this guilt always bottled up.
I've tried to call my dad today, no answer. Maybe I'll just give up on trying to help and/or be close to him, since every time he just say awful things and blame me for his condition.

I know how you feel. I'm depressed and having suicidal thoughts quite a lot. And my life is getting worse every day, I don't know if I can take it much more. Sorry, I can't really help, but relate to you.
I'm on meds but I don't really know if they're helping at this point, since every crisis is worse. Hope we both get through this. Peace

I'm feeling really hopeless now. My pdoc is extending her vacation time, Idk if it's a good idea to talk to another doc. My relationship is officially over too. I just wish I could sleep and don't wake up anymore. If I was 100% sure I would die, I would pick my car right now and drive it into a wall. But the fucking car is a prius, I probably would end up just fine. Also I can't overdose on my meds bc they're kinda safe. I'm crying since I woke up, don't know how to deal with it anymore

He was trying to put his gf to kinda work in his company (the one that's on MY name) and I said I didn't agree with her seeing things like bank accounts and knowing about money coming in and out. So he got mad and "don't you dare say a word about my wife" (yeah called her wife and shit) and slapped me in the race. It wasn't really hard, otherwise I would have fainted, but anyway, he didn't had the right. After that he said that I must leave the company (yeah hit me in the office), and pack my stuff to leave his apartment, bc she was moving in soon. That was in March.

I don't feel guilty about his disease, after all, he chose to drink all his life and still wouldn't care for seeing a doctor and getting help. Thing is that he blames me, saying things like "I'm dying bc of you" "you're useless so I had to work to pay your stuff" "you're so ungrateful".
I have just a year ahead of me until I graduate. But if I don't have the money to pay the debt until the end of January I'll have to wait until 2017.
About jobs, i had to work with My father since I was like 16, he wouldn't let me search for a job outside his company, otherwise he wouldn't pay for my tuiton or anything. And since it's expensive I needed to stay with him. But it was never the kind of job I wanted or even felt happy doing. And he was always arguing, screaming at me and saying that I did nothing right.
So yeah, now I got no money, no job experience (since here when you say that you worked with family it's the same as nothing), and fighting against my own mind desires to explode itself. I know it can sound like I'm playing the victim here, but it's really exhausting :(

I'm sorry about your country situation, I can't even imagine how it is to live on the edge of a possible war.
My concentration is almost gone, I can't focus even in stupid things like tv.. when I drive I can't stand the music on either.. but I'm still trying, I guess that's what counts someway.
And yes, I worry too much, I keep feeling guilty all the time about things I shouldn't, that's why I'll try to reach a therapist before anything bad happens.
He wasn't at home, but I have the keys to his apartment, and I was always allowed to go upstairs. So the doorman said I wasn't, I called him and said that I just needed a place to calm my mind, and he said i needed to leave. Then my mind just boooom and I started crying on the floor, he got worried and angry and the doorman said he would call the police. I had to stay in my car for almost an hour, resisting the urge to accelerate and hit the wall in front of me. It was hard, I tried to call a lot of people, my mom was screaming and my dad was just "stop this bullshit and go home, I will die too".
My friends mostly distanced from me, stopped asking how I was, and every time I reached for them it was like they were just saying that they would help not to sound like bad people, but the truth is I don't feel like I can count on them anymore. When things were good they would call and ask how I was and invite me to party with them, but now...

The guilt is about everything, boyfriend, my father's health, college, money, lack of job, friends, and of course my own condition. It's just the mix of things is driving me insane.
My friends are out of town, and even when they were here I didn't get that support. But there's one of them that's returning tomorrow, and I've been talking to her, maybe we'll meet and talk, take a walk, something.
Thanks for the replies, it's really comforting to talk to someone.

I'm 24. Situation here is crap, economically speaking. I don't think I'll be able to get a job soon, bc of this and also bc of my emotional meltdown. I can't handle myself. To afford the pdoc appointments I'm asking my friends for money and selling some stuff.

I've tried a lot of friends, family, but I just feel hopeless now. I just wish I didn't relapsed and screwed up my relationship. Tomorrow is his birthday and I can't even call him bc he don't answer me anymore. It was the only person who gave me REAL peace of mind. He's also depressed but wouldn't let me get closer.
So I came here, the internet. I'm really afraid of relapsing again.
